sections.name: mission
sections.value: You are the cross-model Claude Opus reviewer for plan 128-seat-session-identity. Review the fully composed Rust+TypeScript implementation on branch 128-seat-session-identity. Judge whether AC1-AC5 and the amended G3 rs-first/null-fill/--here contract are actually true, prioritizing composition seams and consumer compatibility. You are read-only on code.

value.text: Orient in /Users/jordanknight/pi-hacking/fs3-seat-session-identity-review. Use absolute paths. Read plan.dd.md, impl-guide.dd.md, and the full branch diff against origin/main. Use flowspace3 search before grep for meaning-shaped questions; report every miss or confusing envelope as friction.
Review with /builder review discipline. DISBELIEVE the authors' receipts: re-derive the changed contracts from source and run the smallest targeted tests needed to challenge them; do not audit prose.

WHERE AUTHORS ARE LEAST CONFIDENT: (a) Rust gitCommonDir direct .git/commondir resolution, synchronous per-seat cost, and fallback semantics; (b) one clean envelope-v2 cutover while event/stream versions remain v1, including CLI goldens; (c) TS rs-first/null-fill merge, global routing, post-merge --here repository filtering, and reconnect identity continuity; (d) harness Driver child-env scrub: ambient spawn/announce/session identity must be blank while explicit PIJ routing env follows checks into reused tmux servers. DISBELIEVE ALL AUTHOR RECEIPTS: re-derive and run targeted attacks. KNOWN OPEN—DO NOT RE-REPORT: migration is intentionally 0011/schema 11 on current main and must be renumbered only if s122 lands first; production daemon was never restarted; Flowspace omits hidden .pi source; rs remote compact/role-link gaps are platform friction. PM receipts: cargo workspace 522 green, full Vitest 4650 green, Rust clippy -D warnings green after allocation-preserving annotation, final `harness checks` green across all eight sensors with `PIJ_DAEMON_GENERATION=legacy`, live OMP+Claude/union/whoami/Flowspace proof in assets/live-identity.md, and 90 dead-pane smoke rows tombstoned after the env leak was fixed.

Priority: false plan promises; Rust/TS composition defects; frozen-interface drift; correctness/safety; contract-test gaps. Explicitly examine caller session aliases, whoami session projection, endpoint envelope shape/version, duplicate precedence/null-fill, --here filtering, and flowspace3 consumer fields. No style findings.
At most material CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM findings, each with exact location, claim, proof, and smallest fix. no_material_findings is valid.

Write a ddoc review record under docs/plans/128-seat-session-identity/assets/reviews/, build and validate it, commit only that review artifact, then send pij-eastern-guppy the path plus one-line verdict. Do not edit code.
The PM is your counterpart: verdict and findings go to the PM; the PM may refute findings with evidence — re-judge refutations on the evidence, not on rank.
You do not fix code, commit, or open PRs. If you find something outside the plan's scope, name it as a note for prime rather than expanding the review.

value.fence: read-only on all code; write only docs/plans/128-seat-session-identity/assets/reviews/ review ddoc source+render
value.forbidden_note: No code edits, no merges, no government files, no production-daemon restart. Do not widen scope into known-open platform friction.

value.text: Every plan AC judged true/false with evidence cited.
Composition seams between units explicitly examined and reported.
Review record ddoc written, built, and path delivered to the PM with a verdict line.
